rows: A connection is extra structure, not determined by smoothness alone.
Christoffel symbols are not tensor components.
Levi-Civita transport preserves metric, not an ambient vector identity.
Holonomy from parallel transport around closed paths
Holonomy measures global accumulated curvature, not just local coefficients.
Levi-Civita sets torsion to zero; other connections need not.
Unique only after both conditions and the metric are specified.
Geodesics are connection-dependent, not automatically shortest globally.
Differs from Lie derivative, which follows flow without a connection.
